table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	PatientAdmission.AdmissionCode,
	Regno = (SELECT Patient.RegNo FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = PatientAdmission.PatientCode),
	PatientName = (SELECT Patient.Name FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = PatientAdmission.PatientCode),
	Customer = (SELECT Accounts.Name FROM Accounts WHERE Accounts.Acccode = PatientAdmission.CustCode),
	patientageyears=(SELECT Patient.ageyears FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = PatientAdmission.PatientCode),
	patientagemonts=(SELECT Patient.agemonths FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = PatientAdmission.PatientCode),
	patientagedays=(SELECT Patient.agedays FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = PatientAdmission.PatientCode),
	gender=(SELECT Patient.gender FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = PatientAdmission.PatientCode),
	patientadd1=(SELECT Patient.address1 FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = PatientAdmission.PatientCode),
	patientadd2=(SELECT Patient.address1 FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = PatientAdmission.PatientCode),
	patientphone=(SELECT Patient.phone FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = PatientAdmission.PatientCode),
	patientnic=(SELECT Patient.nationalidcard FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = PatientAdmission.PatientCode),
	patientcatname=(select patientcategory.name from patientcategory,patient where patient.patientcode= PatientAdmission.PatientCode and patient.patientcatcode=patientcategory.patientcatcode),
	nextofkins=patientadmission.nextofkins,
	PatientAdmission.PatientCode,   
	PatientAdmission.LocationCode,   
	patientlocationname=patientlocation.name,
	wardname=(select name from ward where ward.wardcode=patientlocation.wardcode),
	PatientLocation.WardCode,
	PatientAdmission.Date,   
	PatientAdmission.DoctorCode,   
	PatientAdmission.UserCode,
	PatientAdmission.DiseaseCode,
	PatientAdmission.Diagnosis,
	PatientAdmission.Remarks,
	PatientAdmission.RecurringServicesChargedOn,
	PatientAdmission.ServiceInvCode,
	PatientAdmission.Discharged1,
	PatientAdmission.Discharged,
	AmountCharged = ISNULL(PatientAdmission.CashCharged,0) + 
		ISNULL((SELECT SUM(MasterCashWin.Amount) FROM MasterCashWin WHERE MasterCashWin.DocumentCode = :ai_code AND MasterCashWin.DocumentType = 'PA'), 0)
FROM PatientAdmission, PatientLocation
WHERE PatientAdmission.AdmissionCode = :ai_code AND
		PatientAdmission.LocationCode = PatientLocation.LocationCode
